name: Air filter element cleaning or replacement
quote: Clean or, if necessary, re- place the air filter element more frequently if you are riding in unusually wet or dusty areas.

name: Wash vehicle after riding in rain or near the sea
quote: Be sure to wash the vehicle after riding in the rain or near the sea, because salt is corro- sive to metals.
